name: anecdote
description: Plain third-person narration of something that happened.

name: first-person account
description: Someone tells what they saw or did, in their own voice.

name: letter
description: A letter from one person to another, with a salutation and a sign-off.

name: dialogue
description: An exchange between two or more speakers, as lines of speech with little or no narration.

name: notice
description: A sign, bulletin or posted announcement addressed to whoever reads it.

name: list
description: A numbered or bulleted list whose items add up to a story.

name: diary entry
description: A dated private entry, written for no one else.

name: marginalia
description: Notes left in the margins of a book, possibly by more than one hand, possibly answering each other.

name: transcript
description: A record of testimony, an interview or a hearing, with speaker labels.

name: instructions
description: Directions for doing something, addressed to the person who has to do it.

name: classified ad
description: A want ad, personal ad, or lost-and-found notice.

name: fable
description: A story told aloud, the way it has been passed down, perhaps with a moral.

name: obituary
description: A death notice for a person, an object, a place or an idea.

name: review
description: Someone's opinionated review of a book, a room, a service or an experience.

name: message
description: A short urgent message: a telegram, a note under a door, a text.

name: fragment
description: A piece of a longer document, starting or ending mid-thought.
